sentences.en: I think this one is inferior to that in quality.
sentences.zh: 我认为这个在质量上比那个差。

sentences.en: This novel of his is inferior to the previous one.
sentences.zh: 他的这部小说不如前一部好。

sentences.en: The former is inferior to the latter in some respect.
sentences.zh: 从某些方面来说，前者不及后者。

senses.zh: 较差的，次等的；下级的，下等的；较低的，低于
